title: My First Game Build
author: Patient-Sprinkles920
selftext:
This game was my first other than simple html browser games. I knew nothing about Unity at the start. I used Claude Opus 5.5 to write the Unity scripts and to instruct me on how to use Unity. For graphics I used Grok Imagine mostly to create backgrounds and sprite sheets. [Freesounds.org](http://Freesounds.org) was used for most sound effects. The music I created myself in FL Studio. The game evolved and evolved and evolved until I likely had something like 1,000 hours invested. I kept going until I felt the game play was good and would naturally bring players back. I still enjoy playing the game. Interested in your thoughts on how your first game went and what you think of my games play. It is free to play. It works best on an Android tablet.  
  
[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.oceanstudios.blazesoceanquest&pcampaignid=web\_share](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.oceanstudios.blazesoceanquest&pcampaignid=web_share)
